headline: Matternet Appoints Starbucks EVP Sanjay Shah to Board of Directors
summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., July 30, 2026--Matternet, the world's only FAA Type-Certified drone delivery platform, today announced the appointment of Sanjay Shah to its Board of Directors.
